wins.label: Exceptional revenue acceleration and scale
wins.evidence: surpassing $1 billion in quarterly revenue for the first time as our overall revenue growth continued to rapidly accelerate to 48% year-over-year growth in Q2

wins.label: Record profitability with Rule of 40 score
wins.evidence: our Rule of 40 score continued to climb, reaching 94% in Q2, which is up 11 points quarter-over-quarter, particularly noteworthy given the scale of our business

wins.label: U.S. commercial explosive growth
wins.evidence: U.S. commercial led with 93% year-over-year revenue growth, outpacing our U.S. government revenue growth of 53% year-over-year

wins.label: Record bookings and customer expansion
wins.evidence: We booked our highest TCV and ACV ever last quarter with $2.3 billion in TCV and $684 million in ACV. We closed a whopping 157 deals worth $1 million or more

wins.label: Major government contracts and military adoption
wins.evidence: Last week, Palantir was awarded a 10-year enterprise agreement with the Army, totaling up to $10 billion, consolidating 75 contracts into a single contract

risks.label: International commercial revenue decline
risks.evidence: Second quarter international commercial revenue declined 3% year-over-year and grew 2% sequentially to $144 million

risks.label: Strategic commercial contracts declining
risks.evidence: We anticipate third quarter 2025 revenue from these contracts to be between $2 million to $4 million compared to $10 million in the third quarter of 2024

risks.label: Seasonal expense ramp expected
risks.evidence: we expect a significant ramp in expenses in the third quarter due to the seasonality of new hire starts
